purpose: Analysis-only finer atomization of the unchanged accepted saved diamond; no new game implementation.

coordinate_contract.source_grid: Columns east, rows south; source east=16*column,north=−16*row.
coordinate_contract.display_grid: X=source column+4;Y=5−source row. Labels mark tile centres.

rendering.road_lines: Every actual saved route, including both elevated decks, ground cars, pedestrian paths, and traffic arrows.
rendering.model_outlines: Union of actual indexed saved triangle projections per proposed whole-cell owner; not inferred tile rectangles.
rendering.svg_editability: Ownership, routes, grid, labels, dimensions, and profiles are vectors; model outlines and actual indexed profile faces are embedded PNG layers.
rendering.profile_axes: Run 0–16 m; height 0–5 m; separate horizontal and vertical scales.
